Package hadur2.core.melee

package hadur2.core.melee
Melee (free-for-all) subsystems: opponent tracking, sweep radar, minimum-risk movement, target selection, circular targeting and posture strategy, driven each tick by MeleeController. Plain Java like the rest of the core: no Robocode (CORE-1), no randomness or I/O (RES-6).
